desc: Calculate the cost function for any subarray of length $x$ efficiently, recognizing that the optimal target value to minimize operations is the median of the subarray elements.
Implement a dynamic programming solution where `dp[i]` stores the minimum operations to form exactly `i` non-overlapping subarrays ending at or before the current index.
Iterate through the `nums` array, updating the DP states by considering ending a new subarray of length $x$ at the current position if enough elements are available.
Ensure non-overlapping constraints are respected by only transitioning from states where the previous subarray ended before the current subarray starts.
Return the value in the DP table corresponding to forming exactly $k$ subarrays after processing the entire array.
Handle edge cases such as when the array length is exactly $k \times x$ or when no valid configuration exists (though constraints guarantee a solution).
Verify the logic with the provided examples.
Ensure edge cases (e.g., k=1, x=nums.length) are handled correctly.
